question: Since 09:12Z the orders API cannot reach its database: every request fails with an authentication error. Why?

plan.rationale: Authentication failures on the orders DB: read the Postgres log group for the verbatim server-side error, then try one authorized read against the orders database to reproduce the rejection from the database side.

hypotheses.statement: The orders-db credential secret was rotated (now v12) but the orders API tasks still present the cached v11 password, so every new connection is rejected by the server with a FATAL authentication error.
arguments_for: Both log events are server-side FATAL 28P01 authentication failures, not timeouts — the database is up and answering
The first failure at 09:12:44Z follows the secret rotation applied at 09:10Z by the platform automation

hypotheses.statement: The orders DB instance itself is down or mid-failover, which is why the API cannot connect.
arguments_for: Connection failures started abruptly this morning
arguments_against: A down instance produces connection timeouts or refused sockets, never a server-side password rejection

findings.title: Stale database credential after secret rotation
findings.detail: The orders-db credential secret was rotated to v12 at 09:10Z, but the orders API tasks still authenticate with the cached v11 password. Every connection since 09:12:44Z is rejected by the server with FATAL 28P01 password authentication failed for user orders_app; the direct audit-DB read from the investigator is rejected the same way, confirming the credential — not the network or the instance — is the fault.
findings.recommendation: Refresh the orders-db credential in the orders API task definition so it reads secret version v12, then restart the service and confirm a new connection authenticates successfully.

citations.excerpt: Distinguish authentication failures (FATAL 28P01) from capacity failures (FATAL: sorry, too many clients already): the former is a credential or secret-propagation problem, the latter is a connection-pool or instance-limit problem.

demo_script.summary: Root cause confirmed: the orders-db credential was rotated but the API tasks kept the previous secret version, so the server rejects every connection with FATAL 28P01. The instance-down hypothesis is refuted by the server-side nature of the error. One planned probe (authorized read on the orders database) failed with the same verbatim authentication error and is recorded as coverage data, not evidence.
